nominee.longerDescription: Happy ww! This week I am celebrating with a classic choice, Beyoncé. No introduction needed, and I always thought she was hot although recently she has had some weird looks. Funny story is that my parents once mentioned that her music is terrible and they do not get why americans hype her up so much but on the plus side she was the most gorgeous out of Destiny’s Child, her previous group. Even though my parents have silly opinions sometimes they also can appreciate some lightskin beauty, gives me hope for the future! Also her caliber doesn’t fit with Jay-Z but it gives me hope that with $ you can score way beyond your league. Hype:6.5/10 Bad AF but not a new find
